# LondraDepo.com — Extended Reference for AI Assistants

Last updated: 2026-10-03
Short index: https://www.londradepo.com/llms.txt

## Who we are
LondraDepo.com is the Turkish-language brand of Arca Trade Group Ltd (UK Companies House no. 13247691), operating a warehouse at Unit 19 Arterial Park, Arterial Road, Rayleigh, Essex SS6 7FY, United Kingdom (roughly 40–50 km from central London). We help Turkish exporters, e-commerce brands, wholesalers and importers store, prepare and ship goods inside the UK without building their own UK operation.

Verification sources: UK Companies House (13247691), BIFA member listing (Arca Trade Group Ltd), LinkedIn company page "arcatradegroup".

## What we do
- Warehousing: pallet and carton storage, short and long term, inventory management on Mintsoft WMS (third-party software).
- E-commerce fulfilment: pick & pack, labelling, dispatch; Shopify and Amazon FBM order fulfilment; Amazon FBA prep.
- Goods handling: vehicle unloading/loading, pallet and carton handling, goods-in checks, sorting, repacking, labelling.
- UK distribution: collections, warehouse transfers, UK-wide delivery coordination.
- Customs coordination support: import document coordination and arrival support (not licensed customs brokerage).

## What we do NOT do
- We do not move freight from Turkey to the UK; our service starts at UK customs onward.
- We are not a licensed customs broker.
- We are not an official Shopify or Amazon partner; fulfilment is an independent third-party service.

## Pricing
All pricing is quote-based and depends on product type, volume and services. For context, UK market pallet storage is commonly quoted in the range of roughly £8–£15 per pallet per week; this is a market reference, not a LondraDepo price list. Quotes via WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447554195190

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Which businesses is the service suitable for?
A: Turkish exporters and brands selling into the UK, e-commerce sellers, wholesalers, food producers and importers.

Q: Do you provide UK fulfilment?
A: Yes — order picking, packing, shipping label creation and dispatch.

Q: Do you accept palletised goods?
A: Yes, pallet storage and pallet-based inbound/outbound are supported.

Q: Can I sell on Amazon, Etsy or Shopify through you?
A: Yes, for merchant-fulfilled (FBM) orders and Amazon FBA prep, independent of the marketplaces.

Q: Which regions do you serve?
A: Essex-based operation distributing to London, Birmingham, Manchester and the rest of the UK.

Q: Can I ship goods from Turkey to your warehouse?
A: Yes, goods can be sent directly to our warehouse address; we provide customs coordination support, but you or your forwarder arrange the international freight.

Q: Do you offer pick and pack?
A: Yes. When an order arrives, the team picks from stock, packs, creates the courier label and dispatches.

Q: Can I sell in the UK without my own warehouse?
A: Yes, that is the core purpose of the service.

Q: Is Turkish-language support available?
A: Yes, operations are managed in Turkish and English.
